ma.loadFontFace(Object object)

Dynamically load network fonts. The file address must be of the download type (Minimum version: 23.6.0).

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
global Boolean false No Indicates whether to take effect globally.
family String Yes Defined font name
source String Yes Address of the font resource. The recommended formats are TTF and WOFF. WOFF2 is incompatible with earlier iOS versions.
success Function No Callback function that is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function that fails to be invoked
complete Function No Callback function that ends the interface invoking (executed when the interface is successfully invoked or fails to be invoked)
desc attribute
Structure Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
style String 'normal' No Font style. The options are normal, italic, and oblique.
weight String 'normal' No Font thickness. The options are normal / bold / 100 / 200.. / 900
variant String 'normal' No Sets the font display text of small uppercase letters. The options are normal, small-caps, and inherit.
object.success callback function
Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
status String Font loading result
object.fail callback function
Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
status String Font loading result
object.complete callback function
Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
status String Font loading result

Sample Code

ma.loadFontFace({
    family: 'Bitstream Vera Serif Bold',
    source: ' url("https://testExample/fontName.ttf")', //This is only an example and is not a real resource link.
    success: function (res) {
        console.log(res)
    }
})
